title: StudyHub update history
description: metadata/updates.json — the What's new list. Newest first. The app compares entry ids with the ids this browser has already seen; it never checks a server.

id.description: Unique, permanent kebab-case id (convention: <date>-<short-name>). Never change it: browsers remember which ids they have seen.

description.description: One sentence. Counts must match the metadata at release time.

link.description: Optional in-app route to open, e.g. #/c/computer-networks.
